newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE looking at Yoshitomi, Green Cross share prices.
newsitem.headline: TSE looking at Yoshitomi, Green Cross share prices.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange said on Tuesday it had started investigations into the share prices of Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd and Green Cross Corp after the two firms said they would merge.

But TSE officials said that the checks were standard procedure after an announcement of any important news which could affect stock prices, and was not specifically an investigation of possible insider trading.
"Whether or not insider trading took place cannot be decided on share price movements alone," an exchange official said.
The two pharmaceutical companies announced their intention to merge on October 1 after the market closed on Monday.
Immediately before the close, Green Cross shares rose, sparking rumours of insider trading, brokers said.
Green Cross shares closed up 36 yen at 566 on Monday, while Yoshitomi shares fell 10 yen to 890.
Shares in both companies were down from their Monday closing levels in afternoon trading in Tokyo, with Green Cross sliding 52 yen to 514 yen and Yoshitomi falling 49 yen to 841 yen.
Both shares were among the five biggest percentage losers on the first section of the exchange.
